title: Chaco Canyon
summary: Chaco Canyon was the centre of the Chacoan world, which Ancestral Pueblo people built up in stages from about 850 and which flourished for more than 300 years. Its great houses were planned multi-storey stone buildings, with dozens in the canyon and over 150 across the region linked by roads. Pueblo Bonito stood four to five stories tall with over 600 rooms.

uncertainty.note: NPS says Pueblo Bonito was planned and built in stages between 850 CE and 1150 CE and that Chacoan culture lasted over 300 years; new construction slowed in the 1100s and 1200s.

as_recorded.value: planned and built it in stages between 850 CE and 1150 CE
